verdict.rationale: Claude Agent SDK is itself the official first-party SDK (Python and TypeScript), with extensive documented APIs for tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, permissions, sessions, streaming, structured outputs, and production hosting, plus a GitHub package that bundles the CLI. This directly satisfies 'build against official SDKs' for an AI-native developer persona. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK ergonomics beyond vendor docs, and some community reports note DX friction/observability gaps with the default harness (not outright contradicting the capability but tempering the polish).
